node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-two-one common-quadratic compiler
node.statement: In a cubic 3+2+1 packet, exact double multiplicity gives a common monic quadratic Q with G=Q(W)(W-y) and F-B=Q(W)(W-z). Writing a=y-z, one has F=G+aQ+B and aQ(y)=(lambda-1)B. The first three HNF coefficients eliminate a,g_2,B triangularly, leaving five exact equations in only (g_1,y,r,d) for each role value lambda.
node.notes: Exact factor and triangular coefficient compiler only. No one of the at most 42 role packets is declared empty, and all norm, Frobenius, cyclotomic, and inner filters remain open.
